# gigahost_dns_zone_nameservers (Resource)

Manages the registry nameservers of a domain registered with Gigahost. The new nameservers must answer authoritatively for the domain, otherwise Gigahost reverts the change. Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state; the nameservers are left unchanged, because a registered domain always needs at least two.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone_nameservers" "example" {
  zone_id = gigahost_dns_zone.example.zone_id
  nameservers = [
    "ns1.example.net",
    "ns2.example.net",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nameservers` (Set of String) Registry nameservers for the domain. At least two are required. Using `ns1.gigahost.no` marks the domain as hosted on Gigahost nameservers; any other set marks it as externally hosted.
- `zone_id` (String) Id of the DNS zone (registered domain).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Nameservers can be imported by their zone id.
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone_nameservers.example 123
```
